pairs.title: SCR-9 Lesson workspace
checks: The left nav is a narrow (about 60 px) icon rail with the blue product mark, not a text sidebar
The top bar holds the breadcrumb and the page status (presence or save state), with the account at the right
Rendered in the light theme (cool grey desk, white sheets), design.md's default
The stepper is centred above the page, all five steps on one line
Three columns: the section outline (about 160 px), the page sheet, the evidence rail (about 360 px)
The formatting toolbar is one compact strip across the top of the page sheet
The lesson reads as one document: section label rows over hairlines, no boxed text fields
Issue cards are compact, and each card's actions sit inside the card
One footer bar under the outline and the page: disclosure at the left, the blocking count once and Submit at the right
